sentences.text: We are confident in the team and the opportunity, and we look forward to providing further updates as the hold progresses.
The numbers tell one story; the team's transformation tells the bigger one.
The investment fits well with the broader portfolio strategy.
We will provide further detail when the work is sufficiently advanced.
We have high conviction in the management team and the value creation plan, and we look forward to providing further updates as the hold progresses.
Our investment team has been preparing Fund V's pipeline for many months and we expect first capital calls in the second quarter of 2026.

part2.statementText: The fund intends to build a portfolio of 10-14 control-oriented investments, with equity checks of EUR 80-100 million apiece.
